verdict.rationale: Cline's headless CLI, cron-scheduled hub agents, web-based Kanban board with parallel worktrees/auto-commit, CI/CD integration, and chat interfaces (Slack/Discord/Telegram/Linear) together let a remote/cloud agent build (edit files, run commands), test (live terminal output, dev servers, tests), and present results for review (diffs, chat, PR-style checkpoints). Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of the full cloud/kanban build-test-demo workflow (community feedback only covers local/editor usage) and no explicit 'demo' artifact generation beyond diffs/chat.
